title: Natural Beacons
description: This project makes naturally spawning beacons, such as iron, gold, emerald, etc.
body:
This pack adds beacons that spawn naturally in your minecraft world. These beacons include:

Iron beacons

Gold Beacons

Emerald Beacons

Diamond Beacons

Netherite Beacons

_(Note: The Beacons are not as large as the cover picture suggests)_
